annotation.bound_parties_text: The terminology standard imposes no obligations on any party; it only notes that users are responsible for establishing their own safety, health and environmental practices.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: It is the responsibility of the user of this standard to establish appropriate safety, health, and environmental practices
annotation.legal_effect_quote: This standard does not purport to address all of the safety concerns, if any, associated with its use.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: This terminology covers terms associated with robotic, automation, and autonomous systems.
